review_candidates.title: Architect
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Architect is responsible for developing architectural concepts, designs, and technical solutions that meet functional, aesthetic, regulatory, and project requirements. This role involves contributing to projects throughout the design and delivery process, from initial planning and concept development through detailed design, documentation, coordination, and project support. You will work closely with clients, project managers, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to understand project objectives and translate requirements into practical and well-designed architectural solutions. The role requires creativity, technical knowledge, strong attention to detail, and the ability to balance design quality with functionality, cost, sustainability, and project requirements. Key responsibilities include preparing architectural concepts, layouts, drawings, specifications, presentations, and design documentation. You will review project requirements, assess site and space considerations, and develop solutions that align with the intended purpose and overall design vision. The role may involve developing designs for residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, mixed-use, industrial, or other types of projects. You will contribute to space planning, building layouts, material selection, design coordination, and the preparation of architectural documentation. The Architect will coordinate closely with structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and other engineering disciplines to ensure that designs are properly integrated. You will review technical requirements, identify potential coordination issues, and support practical solutions throughout the design process. You will also consider applicable building codes, planning requirements, accessibility standards, safety considerations, and other relevant regulations. Ensuring that architectural designs are developed in accordance with approved requirements and project standards is an important part of the role. The position may involve supporting design reviews, client presentations, project meetings, and discussions with external stakeholders. You will communicate design concepts clearly and respond to feedback while maintaining the overall integrity and objectives of the project. During project delivery, you may review drawings and technical submissions, coordinate design changes, respond to technical queries, and provide architectural support to project and construction teams. You may also participate in site visits and inspections to review progress and help ensure that completed work remains consistent with approved designs. The role requires strong documentation and organizational skills. You will maintain accurate drawings, specifications, design revisions, reports, and other project records throughout the development process. You may contribute to improving design processes, exploring innovative materials and technologies, and identifying opportunities to enhance sustainability, efficiency, functionality, and user experience. Success in this role requires a combination of creative thinking, technical competence, communication skills, and practical problem-solving. You should be able to manage multiple design priorities while maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and professional practice. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Architecture or a related discipline. Strong understanding of architectural design principles, space planning, building systems, and construction processes. Ability to develop architectural concepts from initial planning through detailed design and documentation. Strong ability to interpret project briefs, technical requirements, drawings, and specifications. Knowledge of building codes, planning requirements, accessibility standards, and relevant regulations. Strong understanding of construction materials, building methods, and architectural detailing. Excellent design, visualization, and creative problem-solving skills. Ability to prepare architectural drawings, layouts, specifications, and presentation materials. Strong attention to detail and commitment to design quality and accuracy. Ability to coordinate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors, clients, and project teams. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. Strong organizational and project coordination abilities. Ability to manage multiple design tasks, revisions, and project priorities. Proficiency in architectural design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, or similar tools. Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and digital design workflows is beneficial. Knowledge of visualization and rendering tools is considered an advantage. Understanding of sustainable design principles, energy efficiency, and environmentally responsible building practices is beneficial. Ability to review technical submissions and coordinate design changes. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Professional registration, licensing, or architectural certification is considered an advantage where applicable. A creative, detail-oriented, collaborative, and solutions-focused approach to architectural design.
